programme_name_es: Máster Universitario Erasmus Mundus en Ondas, Acústica, Vibraciones, Ingeniería y Sonido
programme_name_en: Erasmus Mundus Master Degree in Waves, Acoustics, Vibrations, Engineering and Sound (WAVES)
institution: Conjunto Internacional — Universitat Politècnica de València (ES, Campus de Gandia); Universidade de Coimbra (PT); Aix-Marseille Université (FR); École Centrale de Marseille / Centrale Méditerranée (FR)
institution_type: public (international joint consortium / Erasmus Mundus Joint Master)
city: Gandia (Valencia) for the Spanish semester; Coimbra (PT), Marseille (FR) for the others
official_status: máster universitario (official, Conjunto Internacional). RUCT estado: 'Publicado en B.O.E.'; nivel académico Máster - RD 1393/2007, MECES 3; fecha de verificación 11/03/2021; BOE 15/01/2022. The UPV programme page additionally states 'Title in the process of renewal'.
language_of_instruction: English. Consortium FAQ verbatim: 'All courses are taught in English so that English proficiency is required.' UPV programme page states language: 'English'.
language_requirement: English proficiency required. Consortium FAQ accepts CEFR B2 certificates, Cambridge English First, TOEFL or IELTS, or proof of 6+ months of academic/professional experience in an English-speaking country. No Spanish requirement (Spanish semester is taught in English).
tuition_year_of_rates: 2025-26 (UPV 'Importe de los derechos y precios públicos de máster oficial', Decreto 101/2024 de 2 de agosto del Consell; 2027-28 rates NOT YET PUBLISHED)
non_eu_surcharge: YES — CONFIRMED, and it is a 100% surcharge (double price). UPV tariff sheet, section 'Precios públicos para el estudiantado extranjero', verbatim: 'Al estudiantado de nuevo ingreso extranjero, que no tenga la condición de residente, excluidos los nacionales de Estados miembros de la Unión Europea y aquellos a quienes les sea de aplicación el régimen comunitario, se les aplicará el doble de los precios públicos establecidos para cada titulación.' It also closes the residency loophole verbatim: 'la autorización de estancia concedida a los estudiantes extranjeros de acuerdo con el Real Decreto 557/2011 ... no equivaldrá a la condición de residentes.' Base Erasmus Mundus rate 39.27 EUR/credit -> 78.54 EUR/credit for a Tunisian non-resident. ARITHMETIC: 39.27 x 2 = 78.54; 78.54 x 120 = 9,424.80. The UPV programme page quotes only the undoubled figure (39.27 EUR/credit = 4,712.40 for 120 credits, 'for both Type 1 and Type 2 students'), which does NOT reflect the non-EU doubling. NOTE: an EMJM scholarship normally covers participation costs in full — see scholarships_internal.
entry_requirements: UPV admission page: 'an official Spanish university degree or other equivalent degree issued by a higher education institution belonging to the European Higher Education Area'; a bachelor's degree in acoustics or a related field — Telecommunication, Sound and Image Systems Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Architecture 'or equivalent'. Selection on academic record, adequacy of prior training to the master profile, professional or research experience, and motivation. English proficiency (B2 or equivalent) required.
accepts_engineering_background: PARTIAL / RISK — INFERRED, not explicit. The named entry profiles are acoustics-adjacent engineering (telecommunications, sound & image systems, industrial, mechanical, architecture) plus 'or equivalent'. A pure Software Engineering degree is NOT named. A candidate with no acoustics/physics/signal-processing coursework is at real risk of being judged inadequate on 'adecuación de la formación al perfil del máster'. Do NOT record this as an accepted background.
complementary_credits_required: NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT (ects_complementos_formativos = null in the RUCT record for 4317455). The UPV admission page does not address complementos de formación. NOT FOUND at applicant level.
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND. Neither the UPV admission page nor the consortium site addresses reconocimiento de créditos or advanced standing for a 300-ECTS entrant. UPV publishes a fee for 'Estudio de solicitudes de convalidación de asignaturas o de reconocimiento de créditos correspondiente a estudios extranjeros' (143,73 EUR), which shows the procedure exists, but no programme-level rule was found.
application_window_2027: NOT FOUND for the September 2027 intake — and there is a serious prior question about whether the programme will recruit at all. THE DECISIVE FACT: the consortium site master-waves.eu states that as of 1 October 2025 'it has been decided not to open the recruitment campaign for a 2026-2028 cohort', and the application platform (application.master-waves.eu) is unavailable. No statement was found either way about a 2027-2029 cohort. Separately, UPV publishes its OWN pre-registration calendar for the Spanish title; the most recent published calendar is for the 2026-27 intake, NOT 2027-28: 'Phase 0 (international students outside EU): November 17, 2025 - February 13, 2026; Phase 1 (all students): March 2 - April 30, 2026; Phase 2: June 15-26, 2026; Phase 3: July 31-August 7 and August 24-September 4, 2026.' These are 2026-27 dates recorded as such; the 2027-28 equivalents are not yet published and MUST NOT be assumed to be the same dates shifted by one year. ACTION FOR A HUMAN: contact the consortium before planning on this programme.

application_rounds.round: UPV Phase 0 — international students from outside the EU (2026-27 intake, NOT 2027-28)

non_eu_early_round_advised: YES — structurally required. UPV runs a dedicated 'Phase 0' reserved for students from outside the EU which opens roughly 3.5 months before the general Phase 1 and closes before it opens. For EMJM funding the binding deadline is the consortium's own scholarship round (historically autumn/winter of the preceding academic year), not the UPV phases.
curriculum_summary: 120 ECTS over 2 years, 4 semesters, 3 countries. RUCT breakdown: 90 ECTS obligatorios + 30 ECTS TFM, 0 optativos, 0 prácticas. Mobility: S1 Universidade de Coimbra (PT); S2 Universitat Politècnica de València, Gandia campus (ES); S3 Aix-Marseille Université + Centrale Méditerranée (FR); S4 internship/thesis placement, described by the consortium as 'worldwide' across 20 Associated Partners and 21 Industrial Partners. Content: acoustical engineering from advanced modelling of wave phenomena through to sustainable development of silent transport systems in urban areas. Awards multiple national master degrees plus a Joint Diploma Supplement.
notable_faculty_or_lab: UPV Campus de Gandia (Escola Politècnica Superior de Gandia) — acoustics engineering; Aix-Marseille / Centrale Méditerranée acoustics groups (LMA Marseille); Universidade de Coimbra.
industry_links: Consortium lists 20 Associated Partners and 21 Industrial Partners hosting the semester-4 internship worldwide.
thesis_or_internship: Both — semester 4 is an internship placement culminating in a 30-ECTS TFM (RUCT: 30 ECTS TFM).

scholarships_internal.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master scholarship (EMJM)
scholarships_internal.detail: The programme is an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master, so the EU EMJM scholarship route applies in principle: for EMJM the scholarship application is normally THE SAME application as admission, submitted through the consortium's own platform, with no separate scholarship form. HOWEVER the consortium states it did not open the 2026-2028 recruitment campaign and the application platform is down, so no scholarship round could be verified as open. Scholarship amounts, number of scholarships and any Partner-Country top-up were NOT FOUND on the consortium site (the FAQ page does not carry them).

scholarships_internal.name: Scholarship places quoted on the UPV admission page
scholarships_internal.detail: UPV admission page mentions 'a total of 20 places for the 2024/2025 academic year' with scholarship support, plus additional funding routes via the Spanish Ministry of Education, the Generalitat Valenciana and UPV's own grants. These are 2024/25 figures and are NOT a statement about 2027.

conflicts.value_a: master-waves.eu: as of 1 October 2025 'it has been decided not to open the recruitment campaign for a 2026-2028 cohort'; application platform unavailable
conflicts.value_b: UPV programme page still advertises the master with a September 2026 - July 2028 run and a full 2026-27 pre-registration calendar, while also noting 'Title in the process of renewal'

conflicts.value_b: master-waves.eu does not name a coordinator in the fetched content — coordinator NOT independently confirmed

notes: HIGHEST-FUNDING-VALUE RECORD IN THE BATCH, AND THE NEWS IS BAD. This is the only Erasmus Mundus / Conjunto Internacional title in batch-08. EMJM funding would have been the strongest remaining route for this candidate (wave 3 established AECID, Becas MEC and Fundación Carolina are all closed to him), and Tunisia's Partner Country status normally increases the award. But the consortium has publicly declined to open a 2026-2028 cohort, and no 2027-2029 cohort has been announced. Do not plan a September 2027 application around this programme without a direct written answer from the consortium. Field fit is also weak-to-moderate: this is acoustical/vibration engineering (path C), not music computing or MIR. Non-EU cost if it did run and no scholarship were won: 9,424.80 EUR for the full 120 ECTS at doubled Valencian rates, plus 27,34 EUR expediente, 155,22 EUR foreign-degree equivalence study, 212,07 EUR title issue, 50,00 EUR title postage outside Europe.
